Add.claim: The sum word and carry reconstruct the unsigned sum including the input carry.
Add.limits: 64-bit uint only. Go requires the input flag to be zero or one. The model uses widened arithmetic. The source bitwise flag calculation is tested on Go. Timing is outside the claim. Boundary cases and 60,000 seeded inputs (17, 2718, 65537).
Add.configurations: Native Go with default lowering and with intrinsics disabled in the driver and math/bits.

Div.claim: Return the Euclidean quotient and remainder when the quotient fits. Panic for a zero divisor or quotient overflow, with zero divisor taking precedence.

Rem.claim: The source-shaped model agrees with the arithmetic model at both uint widths. It returns the Euclidean remainder or reports a divide-by-zero panic.
Rem.limits: Lean proves equivalence of the source-shaped and arithmetic models on all inputs, including the normalized 64-bit path. Source correspondence is checked by inspection. Comparisons with compiled Go are sampled.
Rem.configurations: Native Go, with default lowering and with intrinsics disabled in the driver and math/bits. CI matrix covers Linux/amd64, Linux/arm64 and macOS/arm64. CI also runs the native Linux/386 wrapper.

Rem32.claim: Return the Euclidean remainder even when the quotient overflows. Panic for a zero divisor.
